title: Prespecified 8000-work sample
description: One sampled work; stratified SRSWOR and window endpoints.
code:
frame_sql='''WITH r AS (SELECT citing_work_id AS work_id, list(DISTINCT cited_work_id ORDER BY cited_work_id) AS refs FROM citations WHERE regexp_full_match(cited_work_id,'W[0-9]+') AND citing_work_id<>cited_work_id GROUP BY 1), y AS (SELECT w.work_id, sum(y.cited_by_count) later_year_citations FROM works w JOIN work_citations_by_year y ON y.work_id=w.work_id AND y.year>w.publication_year AND y.year<=2026 GROUP BY 1), l AS (SELECT w.work_id, count(DISTINCT c.citing_work_id) local_later_citations FROM citations c JOIN works w ON c.cited_work_id=w.work_id JOIN works s ON c.citing_work_id=s.work_id AND s.publication_date>w.publication_date GROUP BY 1) SELECT w.work_id, w.publication_date, w.publication_year, w.authors_count, w.cited_by_count AS snapshot_cited_by_count, w.type, w.primary_topic_id, w.primary_field, w.primary_subfield, w.source_id, w.referenced_works_count, coalesce(len(r.refs),0) AS usable_refs, coalesce(y.later_year_citations,0) AS later_year_citations,coalesce(l.local_later_citations,0) AS local_later_citations, r.refs FROM works w LEFT JOIN r USING(work_id) LEFT JOIN y USING(work_id) LEFT JOIN l USING(work_id) ORDER BY work_id'''
from datetime import date, timedelta
frame=sql(frame_sql); frame['frame_status']=np.select([frame.usable_refs.eq(0),frame[['snapshot_cited_by_count','later_year_citations','local_later_citations']].max(axis=1).le(0)],['no_usable_refs','no_citation_evidence'],default='eligible'); labels=[str(i) for i in range(1,11)]+['11–20','21–50','51–100']; frame['stratum']=pd.cut(frame.authors_count,[0,*range(1,11),20,50,100],labels=labels).astype(str)
N=frame[frame.frame_status.eq('eligible')].groupby('stratum').size().reindex(labels); n=N*0
while n.sum()<8000:
 for h in labels:
  if n[h]<N[h] and n.sum()<8000: n[h]+=1
rng=np.random.Generator(np.random.PCG64(42)); s=pd.concat([frame[(frame.stratum==h)&frame.frame_status.eq('eligible')].iloc[np.sort(rng.choice(N[h],n[h],replace=False))] for h in labels],ignore_index=True); s.insert(0,'sample_id',np.arange(1,len(s)+1)); s['N_h']=s.stratum.map(N); s['n_h']=s.stratum.map(n); s['pi']=s.n_h/s.N_h; s['weight']=1/s.pi
s['main_end']='2026-11-23'; s['fixed_end']=s.publication_year.map(lambda y:f'{y+2}-12-31'); s['fixed_snapshot_supported']=s.publication_year.lt(2024); s['observed_fixed_end']=s[['main_end','fixed_end']].min(axis=1); s['start_date']=(s.publication_date+pd.Timedelta(days=1)).dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
pairs=s[['work_id','stratum','refs']].explode('refs').rename(columns={'refs':'reference_id'}); loc=frame.set_index('work_id')[['publication_year','snapshot_cited_by_count']]; unique=pd.Index(pairs.reference_id.unique()).sort_values(); missing=unique.difference(loc.index)
print(frame.frame_status.value_counts(),pd.DataFrame({'N':N,'n':n}),s.publication_year.value_counts(),s.usable_refs.describe(percentiles=[.9,.95,.99]),len(pairs),len(unique),len(missing)); print(s.usable_refs.map(lambda x:(x)//100).value_counts().sort_index()); print(s[s.usable_refs>=480][['sample_id','work_id','usable_refs','stratum','snapshot_cited_by_count']].to_string(index=False))
print(save_table(frame.drop(columns='refs'),'Local proxy frame','One snapshot work; screen and local covariates.')); print(save_table(s.drop(columns='refs'),'Prespecified 8000-work sample','One sampled work; stratified SRSWOR and window endpoints.')); print(save_table(pairs,'Sample reference edges','One focal work and distinct valid nonself reference.'))
